versions.content: Synchronization constraint on events Type: valid Description: The Timing Extension shall enable on to impose synchronization constraints on two or more timing descrition events. Rationale: While building up systems it is necessary to specify that the occurrence of events shall be synchronous, like in case of a turn signal indicator, anti blocking systems where information from several wheels are important. Use Case: None Dependencies: [RS_TIMEX_00001] 5 20 of 34  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 410: AUTOSAR_RS_TimingExtensions Requirements on Timing Extensions AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Supporting Material: None
